calls.title: funnels spec and kick off
calls.summary: The team discussed the creation of funnel metrics as a distinct, reusable metric type, emphasizing the need for separate user interfaces for quick analysis and experimentation. Luke Sonnet clarified that on-the-fly analyses would exist within Product Analytics without persistence beyond simple uses, while authoritative metrics would be materialized for experiments. The conversation underlined the importance of consistent styling and terminology to enhance user recognition, with Kari Kay and Lillia Jackson advocating for unique presentation styles and clear naming conventions. The visualization of funnel metrics will be improved for deeper insights. Challenges related to funnel slicing were acknowledged, leading to a decision not to support slices in version 1 to concentrate on core features. Next steps include refining funnel examples and aligning UI/UX designs.
calls.keywords: funnel metrics, product analytics, metric slices, UX design, experiment results, data visualization
